subphase: S65: mechanism-oriented workload templates, an enforced consumer-API invariant, and a typed library-harness path

execution.note: all builds, workloads and probes ran inside the expansion court container; the host ran no project command

recipe_reuse.effect: recipe_specs() emits no recipe for these rows, so the family's existing admitted pristine recipe (with its auxiliary pins) is not shadowed; the template row contributes only runtime intent + workload

templates.name: x509_verification
templates.positive: gftp-text performs an explicit-AUTH-TLS FTPS transfer with SSL_CERT_FILE=<fixture CA>; the downloaded payload equals the fixture
templates.negative: the same peer and URL with SSL_CERT_FILE=<unrelated CA>; the peer's chain must be rejected and no payload delivered
templates.fixture_note: the released master gftprc ships verify_ssl_peer=0; the workload re-enables the secure upstream default in the installed master config (family scratch, not a source patch) before either run

templates.name: evp_signing
templates.positive: bootgen signs a 4096-bit RSA authenticated boot image and its own verifier reports 'Authentication is verified'
templates.negative: one byte at offset -100 of the signed image is flipped; the verifier must report 'Authentication verification failed' (exit 1) and must not report success

result.candidate_cause: bootgen signing segfaults against the candidate libcrypto (sign exit=-11, no image); the authority signs and verifies, so the fixture is sound

templates.name: aead_roundtrip
templates.positive: the typed harness drives Poco's AES-256-GCM encryptor/decryptor through the public API; the decrypted payload equals the input (aead_roundtrip=ok)
templates.negative: the same ciphertext with the GCM tag's first byte flipped must be rejected (aead_tamper=rejected; Poco's finalize throws)

templates.name: hmac_kdf
templates.positive: bootgen's SP 800-108 counter-mode KDF reproduces the published KO F67D17DDF07D3579CCED1CE404E9854C12C25F8CFB2B6EE74508F13C7797F8E1 and prints 'Verified with given Ko'
templates.negative: the same vector with a one-bit-different KI prints KO 86BE87F36A3E5CACA0BC8A060B62239D6296AA3A3B7C4E9B984D81ED4CAC45D7, which differs from the published output
templates.mechanism_note: the configured PRF is the consumer's own (Bootgen uses AES-CMAC counter mode, not HMAC); the template contract is a keyed-KDF known output plus a wrong-key difference, and the family's PRF is not relabelled

result.candidate_cause: the family row is L5 because the evp_signing workload in the same entry segfaults; the KDF workload itself reproduced the vector and the wrong-key control

consumer_api_invariant.enforcement: every mechanism handler calls it before returning; a false result is returned as failure_class=harness-failure with reason 'false-L7 rejected by the consumer-API invariant: ...' and can never be promoted to L7
verified_rule: limb 1: the consumer artifact (the family's program, or each named consumer shared library) must have at least one undefined OpenSSL symbol in its own dynamic symbol table (nm -D -u); a program that merely links OpenSSL without calling it is refused

limb 2 (library mode): the workload must resolve the configured consumer library in its ldd closure; the typed harness must reference at least one symbol that library exports; and the harness's own undefined symbols must contain zero OpenSSL symbols

self mode: the family's executable is the consumer, so its OpenSSL imports are the workload's OpenSSL calls; the Python fixture peer is recorded separately as fixture_openssl and is never counted as the consumer
consumer_api_invariant.false_l7_outcome: the harness is rejected, the row records harness-failure/out-of-scope, and no functional result is produced

negative_control.setup: a synthetic libconsumer.so imports EVP_sha256 and exports consumer_do; good calls only consumer_do, bad calls consumer_do and EVP_sha256

bad.reason: the typed harness itself imports OpenSSL (EVP_sha256); the workload must exercise the consumer's OpenSSL path, not reimplement it in the harness

consumer_api_invariant.evidence_persisted: downstream_runtime.py writes the gate verdict into each measured row as consumer_evidence beside the level it gated

typed_library_harness.purpose: a minimal, shared shape for a library-only consumer: initialisation -> context construction -> input processing -> output validation -> cleanup -> an explicit error-handling case
typed_library_harness.consumer_api_only: includes only Poco public headers; imports zero OpenSSL symbols (verified by nm -D -u on the compiled harness)

shape.output_validation: decrypt with the tag and compare to the input payload
shape.error_handling: --tamper flips the GCM tag and requires finalize to throw/return non-success

typed_library_harness.runtime_wiring: downstream_runtime._build_harness honors harness.compiler (new: c++); templates.programs() passes through harness and make_steps
typed_library_harness.generality: the path is language-agnostic; existing harnesses use compiler=cc (C), and a C library can be added without changing the runtime or the gate
